moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's duet 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Singles Chart number one spot for a record-breaking 21st non-consecutive week, becoming the longest-running UK number-one single of all time.

angles.name: Chart Record Breakers
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK Number 1 single ever. What an achievement!
